Filter folders by name pattern (case-insensitive regex). Example: 'Performance' will show only folders with 'Performance' in their name. Use this to find specific folders when you don't know the folder ID.

If set, only starred (true) or non-starred (false) documents are returned. Default value is undefined, so no filtering is applied.

If the current context is tied to a folder (when the user opened the assistant from a folder), the folder Id can be provided here to limit the results to what the user is focusing on. The tool will automatically list the content from subfolders, it's enough to specify the folderId from the context. The returned documents and documentCount will only include documents from the specified folder and its subfolders.

The heading level: 'title', 'subtitle', 'heading', 'strong', 'page', or 'body'

The pageContent of a block, that means the content of all its direct children in one string in markdown format. If includeSubPagesRecursively is true, it will include the content of all decendends recursively, not just the direct children.

The start date of the calendar range in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). If not provided the calendar won't show sections for past months, the first section after the 'Ongoing' items will be the today section. Note, that the ongoing section contains tasks from the past, which are still pending. Past sections can only contain completed/cancelled tasks and daily notes.
